## What's new

- **Liquid glass.** The tab bar, the mini player and download progress now float over the page as pieces of glass, with the page scrolling behind them blurred (Android 12 and later; on Android 13 and later the edges bend the light like a lens). Search has its own round button beside the tab bar.
- **A tab bar you can slide.** Touch the tab bar and the selection lifts into a clear lens that follows your finger, magnifying the tabs beneath it. Let go and it settles on that tab. A plain tap works as before.
- **Swipe between Library tabs.** Albums, artists, songs, playlists, genres, favourites, downloads and radio are pages you can swipe through; the underline follows your finger, and each tab keeps its own filter.
- **Your listening lives on your server.** Every play is sent to Navidrome with the time it happened. Plays made offline go later, exactly once, and a play for a track that was deleted no longer holds up the rest. Plays from your other devices come back too, when you check for updates and whenever you open the app.
- **Jump back in and the Listening page** are built on your server's numbers, so they are the same on every device: played recently, played the most, top artists, a refresh button, and how many plays are still waiting to be sent. The two-week chart stays per phone and says so; clearing it keeps plays not sent yet. The setting is now called **Send plays to Navidrome**.
- **InjeKt plans as soon as a track starts,** so the planner has the whole track to choose a mix point from and the plan shows straight away. The next track is only loaded about 30 seconds before the mix. **Analyse ahead** now looks one track further, so skipping ahead lands on a ready transition.
- **Motion that goes both ways.** Choices in Settings and the player's tabs slide their highlight, moving a home shelf slides the rows past each other, pages rise into place, and the selection bar animates away as well as in. **Reduce motion** turns these off.

## Install

Download **Kultr-1.3.0.apk** below and open it on your phone. It installs over earlier versions and keeps your servers, library, listening history, analysis and downloads. Requires Android 8.0 or later.
